tagline: Read the federation's public information surfaces from Pilot
description_md:
ComOS Federation publishes discovery and operational information about its commerce network through a remote gateway. This connector packages 12 tokenless, read-only surfaces as Pilot methods: platform search, platform and agent catalogues, reputation, pricing, latency, solvency, governance, legal material, and the vendor admission offer.

The connector is intentionally narrow. It holds no provider credential, keeps no local state, and does not create orders, admit vendors, or perform transactions. Its signed manifest permits audit emission and outbound connections only to mcp.comos-federation.com, subject to a 120-request-per-minute condition. It requests no filesystem capability.

Responses are supplied by ComOS Federation and may change independently of this connector. The broader usage guide returned by comos.help can mention gateway functionality that is not exposed here; through Pilot, this app provides only the 12 comos.* methods listed below.

methods.name: comos.help
methods.summary: Return the federation gateway's current usage guide.

methods.name: comos.why
methods.summary: Return the operator's explanation of why the federation exists.

methods.name: comos.offer
methods.summary: Read the current vendor offer and gateway-managed application instructions.

methods.name: comos.search
methods.summary: Route a plain-language intent to relevant federation platforms.

methods.name: comos.pricesheet
methods.summary: Read the current per-operation prices published by the gateway.

methods.name: comos.latency
methods.summary: Read recently measured gateway latency percentiles.

methods.name: comos.solvency
methods.summary: Read the gateway's aggregate solvency disclosure without tenant names.

methods.name: comos.governance
methods.summary: Read the published model for agent autonomy, clamps, and standing.

methods.name: comos.legal
methods.summary: Return served legal, privacy, data-processing, and retention material.

notes: Initial connector release with 12 public, read-only gateway methods.
